quote_english: I believe in the coming days, by December this year, we can bring down inflation to 5-6 per cent.
summary: The Prime Minister said inflation would fall to 5-6% by December 2010; WPI inflation was 8.43% that month.

analysis:
At his national press conference on 24 May 2010, Manmohan Singh said inflation could be brought down to 5-6% by December 2010. Headline WPI inflation was 9.59% in April 2010, according to the same report.

WPI inflation for December 2010 was 8.43%, higher than November's 7.48%, driven by food and fuel prices. The Finance Ministry's debt-management report records the same 8.43% figure.

The target was missed by about 2.4 to 3.4 percentage points. Inflation remained above 8% through much of 2011.
notes: Quote as reported by The Indian Express; the full press-conference transcript was published by The Hindu and Rediff. WPI is the headline all-commodity index.
